shortlist: Borderline personality disorder with factitious symptoms

selector.rationale: Evidence of volitional behavior, selective acceptance of medications, and purposeful movements suggest Malingering as the most likely diagnosis, with Factitious disorder being a close second due to similar symptoms but less clear intent to deceive.

rejected.label: Conversion disorder
rejected.why: Presence of strong contradictions, such as self-induced urinary incontinence and lack of response to lorazepam challenge tests, which are not typical of Conversion disorder

rejected.label: Borderline personality disorder with factitious symptoms
rejected.why: While the patient has a history of borderline personality disorder, the current symptoms and behaviors are more suggestive of a factitious or malingered condition rather than a manifestation of the personality disorder itself
